extraction.Name: Minnie Palmier, nee Jensen
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area implied)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of not wanting to pay taxes, but that she was written that she would have taxes to pay any way, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it for $900.00, part in cash and part in trade
extraction.Buyer: Isaac H. Chase, of Rapid City, South Dakota
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; has poor health, being bothered with gall stones; has two minor children; she and two minor children are supported by her husband; has never received any aid from the County or Government; allotment was 160 acres; document notarized November 13, 1928
